SafeSeaNet Norway port notification is general, not TSS-linked, and not counted.

reporting_authority: Irish Coast Guard: MRCC Dublin (communications also via MRSC Valentia and MRSC Malin Head); other WETREP coastal States for their sectors
reporting_boundary_basis: MSC.190(79) para 2.1: the WETREP polygon runs 56°30'N 012°W - 54°40'41"N 015°W - 50°56'45"N 015°W - 48°27'N 006°25'W, with the inner closing point 21 on the Irish east coast (52°10'N 006°22'W). At Fastnet's longitude (c. 009°36'W) the southern boundary line lies near 49°23'N, about 2° south of the TSS, so the TSS (off Fastnet Rock, c. 51°18'-51°23'N) is wholly inside. Applies only to oil tankers >600 dwt carrying heavy crude, heavy fuel oil or bitumen/tar; WETREP does not name the TSS. Pass 4: MSC.190(79) annex para 6.2.1 names 'Off Fastnet Rock' among the TSS in the WETREP area. Applies to oil tankers over 600 dwt carrying heavy grade oil.
evidence_summary: Inside the WETREP (VRS-0005) mandatory reporting area (tankers with heavy grade oil only). The Irish Coast Guard monitors traffic in the TSS, but no declared VTS area was found covering it.
source_date: MSC.190(79) 2004-12-06 (in force 2005-07-01); gov.ie IRCG page modified 2025-07-08; accessed 2026-09-29

TSS coordinates taken from a search snippet only (lead only); inclusion in WETREP rests on the boundary geometry, not on those coordinates.

vts_authority: Direção-Geral de Recursos Naturais, Segurança e Serviços Marítimos (DGRM); statute names IPTM, I.P. (predecessor)
vts_centre: Centro de Controlo de Tráfego Marítimo do Continente (CCTMC), Paço de Arcos
vts_boundary_basis: DL 263/2009 art. 6 VTS area runs from the coast to 010 14 W (north of 38 41 N) and then to 36 30 N 009 35 W; art. 10(4) gives the CCTMC supervision of TSS rules. Coordinate comparison: the westernmost TSS positions (26) 010 13.78 W, (25) 38 40.96 N 010 13.77 W and (24) 38 33.92 N 010 11.69 W all fall inside (margins about 0.2').
reporting_boundary_basis: COPREP area (MSC.278(85)) has the same west and south-west limits; the TSS falls inside on coordinate comparison (TSS not named in COPREP). Also WETREP (VRS-0005): 'Off Cape Roca' named in MSC.190(79) 6.2.1 and inside the area; Portuguese WETREP contact is Roca Control (MSC.301(87)); tanker-only.
evidence_summary: Statutory coastal VTS area and COPREP area both include the TSS on coordinate comparison; WETREP names it. Reports to Roca Control; CCTMC listed as operational 24h/7 under DGRM.
source_date: DL 263/2009; MSC.278(85) 2008 (in force 1 June 2009); COLREG.2/Circ.61 (TSS implemented 1 Dec 2010); EMSA directory accessed 2026
